motivo: Todas las afirmaciones de seguridad (20 pies, garage con puerta abierta, ventilación insuficiente, CO invisible/inodoro, porche/carport) están verificadas en la fuente primaria de EE. UU. (CPSC), con unidades en pies coincidentes. Ninguna es falsa y no hay afirmaciones de dinero ni cifras adicionales. Nota: CPSC dice 'at least 20 feet away from the house'; la guía del CDC es 20 pies de puertas, ventanas y respiraderos (consistente). Un estudio del NIST sugiere que 20 pies es un mínimo, y el guion dice 'at least', así que el matiz es correcto.

afirmaciones.texto: The power's out, so you run the generator in the garage with the door open. (escenario del error cotidiano)
afirmaciones.fuente: CPSC: never use a generator in a garage even if doors/windows are open (cpsc.gov, news release 2026 winter storm safety tips)
CPSC; CDC (cdc.gov/nceh/multimedia/infographics/carbon_monoxide_danger.html): never use generators in garages

afirmaciones.texto: The Consumer Product Safety Commission says an open door or window won't give you enough ventilation to stop carbon monoxide from building up to deadly levels.
afirmaciones.fuente: CPSC: 'Opening doors or windows will not provide enough ventilation to prevent the buildup of lethal levels of CO.' (cpsc.gov/Newsroom/News-Releases/2026/As-Winter-Storms-Threaten-Millions-in-the-US-CPSC-Issues-Safety-Tips-...; también 468_WhattoKnowGenerators_2022.pdf)

afirmaciones.texto: You can't see it or smell it, so you won't know it's there.
afirmaciones.fuente: CPSC: CO es 'colorless, odorless'; CDC infographic: poison gas you cannot see or smell

afirmaciones.texto: Its rule is simple: generators go outside only, at least twenty feet from the house.
afirmaciones.fuente: CPSC: 'operate portable generators outside only, at least 20 feet away from the house'; CDC: al menos 20 pies de puertas, ventanas y respiraderos (pies, unidades coinciden)

afirmaciones.texto: Not on the porch, and not in the carport. Those are too close.
afirmaciones.fuente: CPSC: 'Don't operate a generator on a porch or in a carport' (news release 2026); CDC: nunca en carports

afirmaciones.texto: Save this for the next big storm. / Send this to the friend who already owns a generator. / Have you ever lost power for more than a day? (llamadas a la acción)
afirmaciones.fuente: No aplica: no son afirmaciones fácticas

afirmaciones.texto: Caption: 'run a portable generator outside only, at least 20 feet away from the house... generator = outside only, 20 feet from the house, never in the garage.'
Caption: 'Sources: CPSC winter weather safety tips.'
afirmaciones.fuente: cpsc.gov news release 'As Winter Storms Threaten Millions in the US, CPSC Issues Safety Tips...' (2026): existe y contiene las afirmaciones
